data.disagreement_analysis: The disagreement was caused by a transient API error (HTTP 400 BadRequestError) in the qwen model when attempting to audit the .SRCINFO file. This tool failure incorrectly escalated to an 'inconclusive' package verdict, whereas the deepseek model successfully audited all files and correctly returned 'safe'.
coverage_issues: qwen model failed to audit .SRCINFO due to an HTTP 400 API error.
learnings: Transient API errors (e.g., HTTP 400) during the audit of non-executable metadata files like .SRCINFO should not force an 'inconclusive' security verdict for the entire package. The tool should handle such errors gracefully, perhaps by retrying or excluding non-executable files from the final verdict calculation.
